dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi, Nam! What sports do you play?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈnɑːm! ˈwʌt ˈspɔːrts duː juː ˈpleɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, I don't. But I go jogging after class.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈdoʊnt. bʌt aɪ ˌɡoʊ ˈdʒɑːɡɪŋ ˈæftər ˈklæs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sometimes. And I want to do yoga, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈsʌmtaɪmz. ənd aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈduː ˈjoʊɡə, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Great! There's a yoga class here on Monday evenings.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ðɛrz ə ˈjoʊɡə ˌklæs ˈhɪr ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ ˈiːvnɪŋz.
